LightningComponentBundle.description: The Details tab of the Lightning household record page, redrawn for ARC. Read-only. Reads through ArcRecordDetailController.load using the Household Detail schema type.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: Object whose record page this sits on.

property.name: schemaType
property.label: Fallback Schema Type
property.description: Used only when the record's type is not mapped. Blank renders nothing rather than guessing.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Heading
property.description: Optional heading above the sections. Blank renders none.

property.name: domain
property.label: Egnyte Domain
property.description: Published Experience site domain, forwarded to the Documents tab's Egnyte embed.
